competences.description: Attacks all enemies and weakens their Defense for 1 turn with a 50% chance. This attack ignores all effects that resist death.
Stuns the enemy for 1 turn if the attack lands as a Critical Hit. One of minions' Attack Bar increases by 100% after an enemy is attacked. [Automatic Effect]
Attacks the enemy with minions on both sides. The inflicted damage from the Ancient Guardian's attack is proportionate to the guardian's lost HP.
Attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns and stun them for 1 turn. The cooldown resets if an enemy gets defeated.
